heading.title: Of Offences Affecting the Human Body

article.title: Abetment of suicide of child or person of unsound mind
article.content: If any child, any person of unsound mind, any delirious person or any person in a state of intoxication, commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term not exceeding ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
107Abetment of suicide of child or person of unsound mind

Section 107 · Chapter VI · Of offences affecting life

If any child, any person of unsound mind, any delirious person or any person in a state of intoxication, commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide, shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for a term not exceeding ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
